title: 第1349章 仇恨第1348章 大好河山2
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
（感谢.拉盖.的打赏加更15）
“父亲啊！我的父亲啊！！”
将近两吨炸药爆炸，直接把鹰眼山的山头削平，大量碎石直冲天际，飞到数公里外落下，烟尘窜起几百米高，整个山头灰扑扑一片。
科索普发出一阵大哭声，他直接跪在地上，手疯狂地捶地。
他的哥哥和妈妈，也痛哭不止。
但是科索普哭着哭着，悲伤立马转变成了仇恨！
他一扭头，看向周围举着望远镜，观察炸点的龙虎军军官，突然暴起，冲向一名军官，手直接往他腰间的手枪抓去！
他的动作非常快，而且爆发的太突然了，居然直接把这名军官腰间的手枪给拔了出来，甚至把枪套也给损坏掉了。
随即在众人错愕的注视下，科索普双手握住手枪，对准面前的军官，狠狠扣下扳机！
但是这名军官的手枪是半自动手枪，是联盟最新配发给军队的自卫武器。
它的激发原理和左轮手枪完全不同，科索普不知道怎么用，他连保险都找不到在哪里。
保险没开，所以他用力扣扳机，根本扣不响。
被抢枪的军官这时才反应过来，大怒。
他冲过去，一脚踹在科索普的肚子上，直接把他踹倒在了地上。
然后冲过去，双手反剪，把科索普给按住了，并将自己的手枪给抢了回来。
“我操你个小畜生，是不是想死！”
军官怒极了，全是冷汗。
身为军人，手枪被人夺了，这可是重大事故。
并且这小子夺过枪后，对着他扣了好几下扳机，要不是这小子不会用枪，他就要去冥河畅游了。
前程被毁，以及差点重开的恍惚，让这个军官恨不得当场把科索普毙了。

科索普此时的眼睛里已经全是仇恨，他大喊道：
“杀了我！你杀了我啊！！
你要是不杀了我，我日后一定会杀死你们所有人，为我父亲报仇！”
周围的官兵眼睛出现微信的光，手不自觉摸向腰间的枪械，用充满敌意的目光盯着科索普。
迅拉和他的两个孩子亡魂大冒，赶忙冲过去捂住科索普的嘴，然后不停向周围的官兵解释。
迅拉有些着急的看向厄忒斯。
“元帅，这孩子年纪还小，他脑子不清楚，你千万不要当真。”
厄忒斯叹了一口气。
“所有人，都把你们的枪放一下，这孩子的父亲刚死，要骂就让他骂几句吧。
全都散开，该干什么干什么去。
你，被夺枪那家伙，看好你的枪，另外把他放开，你都快把他给压死了，回去写份报告，晚上交给我！”
被夺枪的军官脸都绿了，冷哼一声后推了一把科索普，站起身，和周围的军官们一起散掉了。
写报告，那就要记录在案了，他的前程算是废掉了。
科索普没人压后，站起身，继续用仇恨的视线看着那些远去的联盟官兵，发出一阵怒骂：
“我会报仇！我会向你们这些入侵者报仇！我会抢回属于我们的土地，我会用你们的人头来祭奠我死去的父亲！”
content_en:
(Thanks to Lagai. for the reward and 15 more updates)
"Father! My father!!"
Nearly two tons of explosives exploded, flattening the top of Eagle Eye Mountain. A large amount of rubble shot straight into the sky, flew several kilometers away and fell. Smoke and dust flew hundreds of meters high, and the entire mountain top was covered in dust.
Kossop let out a loud cry. He knelt on the ground and beat the ground wildly with his hands.
His brother and mother also cried bitterly.
But Kossop cried, and his sadness immediately turned to hatred!
He turned his head and looked around at the officers of the Dragon and Tiger Army who were holding binoculars to observe the explosion point. He suddenly burst out and rushed towards an officer, grabbing the pistol directly at his waist!
His movements were very fast, and the explosion was so sudden that he actually pulled out the pistol from the officer's waist and even damaged the holster.
Then, with everyone watching in astonishment, Kossop held the pistol with both hands, pointed it at the officer in front of him, and pulled the trigger hard!
But the officer's pistol was a semiautomatic, the latest self-defense weapon issued by the alliance to the military.
Its firing principle was completely different from that of a revolver. Kossop didn't know how to use it, and he couldn't even find where the safety was.
The safety wasn't on, so he pulled the trigger hard, but it didn't click.
The officer whose gun was robbed only then reacted and became furious.
He rushed over and kicked Kossop in the stomach, knocking him to the ground.
Then he rushed over, held down Kossop with his hands behind his back, and snatched his pistol back.
"I'll fuck you little beast, do you want to die?"
The officer was so angry that he was covered in cold sweat.
As a soldier, if your pistol is taken away from you, this is a serious incident.
And after this kid grabbed the gun, he pulled the trigger on him several times. If this kid didn't know how to use a gun, he would have gone for a dip in the River Styx.
The ruined future and the uncertainty of almost reopening made the officer want to kill Cossop on the spot.
Kossop's eyes were full of hatred at this time, and he shouted:
"Kill me! Kill me!!
If you don't kill me, I will definitely kill all of you in the future to avenge my father! "
The eyes of the surrounding officers and soldiers flashed with the light of WeChat, their hands unconsciously touched the firearms at their waists, and they stared at Kosopp with hostile eyes.
Xunla and his two children were so distraught that they rushed over to cover Kosopp's mouth, and then kept explaining to the surrounding officers and soldiers.
Xunla looked at Ertes anxiously.
"Marshal, this child is still young and his mind is not clear. You must not take him seriously."
Ertes sighed.
"Everyone, put your guns away. This child's father just died. If you want to scold him, just let him scold him.
Everyone dispersed and went to do whatever they had to do.
You, the guy whose gun was taken away, watch your gun carefully and let him go. You almost crushed him to death. Go back and write a report and give it to me tonight! "
The officer whose gun was taken away turned green. He snorted, pushed Cossop, stood up, and dispersed with the surrounding officers.
If he writes a report, it will be recorded, and his future will be ruined.
With no one to suppress him, Kossop stood up, continued to look at the retreating Alliance officers and soldiers with hateful eyes, and cursed angrily:
"I will take revenge! I will take revenge on you invaders! I will take back the land that belongs to us, and I will use your heads to pay tribute to my dead father!"
